facts.label: official
facts.quote: The weighted average lending rate (WALR) on outstanding rupee loans of SCBs remained unchanged at 8.96 per cent in September 2026 compared to August 2026.
facts.text: The weighted average lending rate on outstanding rupee loans of scheduled commercial banks remained unchanged at 8.96 per cent in September 2026.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The WALR on fresh rupee loans of SCBs declined to 8.51 per cent in September 2026 from 8.61 per cent in August 2026.
facts.text: The weighted average lending rate on fresh rupee loans of scheduled commercial banks declined to 8.51 per cent in September 2026.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: 1-Year median Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate (MCLR) of SCBs declined to 8.55 per cent in October 2026 from 8.61 per cent in September 2026.
facts.text: The one-year median Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate of scheduled commercial banks moderated to 8.55 per cent in October 2026.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The weighted average domestic term deposit rate (WADTDR) on outstanding rupee term deposits of SCBs marginally declined to 6.55 per cent in September 2026 from 6.56 per cent in August 2026.
facts.text: The weighted average domestic term deposit rate on outstanding rupee term deposits eased marginally to 6.55 per cent in September 2026.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The WADTDR on fresh rupee term deposits of SCBs declined to 5.61 per cent in September 2026 from 5.67 per cent in August 2026.
facts.text: The weighted average domestic term deposit rate on fresh rupee term deposits of scheduled commercial banks fell to 5.61 per cent in September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Among bank groups, the WALR on fresh loans declined to 7.93 per cent for public sector banks and 7.76 per cent for foreign banks in September, while private sector banks reported 9.19 per cent.
facts.text: The weighted average lending rate on fresh loans at public sector banks stood at 7.93 per cent in September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Personal loans grew 17.3 per cent to ₹74.27 trillion, moderating from 11.5 per cent growth in the corresponding period last year.
facts.text: Personal loans extended by commercial banks recorded year-on-year growth of 17.3 per cent as of September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Within personal loans, bank credit extended against gold jewellery expanded rapidly, surging 83 per cent Y-o-Y to reach ₹5.6 trillion.
facts.text: Bank advances against gold jewellery expanded 83 per cent year-on-year to reach 5.6 trillion rupees.

topic.summary: Data on lending and deposit rates of scheduled commercial banks (SCBs) (excluding regional rural banks and small finance banks) received during October 2026 are set out in Tables 1 to 9.    Highlights:     Lending Rates:                  The weighted average lending rate (WALR) on outstanding rupee loans of SCBs remained unchanged at 8.96 per cent in September 2026 compared to August 2026.                    The WALR on fresh rupee loans of SCBs declined to 8.51 per cent in September 2026 from 8.61 per cent in August 2026.                    1-Year median Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate (MCLR) of SCBs declined to 8.55 per cent in October 2026 from 8.61 per cent in September 2026.                    The WALR on fresh as well as outstanding rupee loans exhibited a mixed movement across sectors in September 2026.              Deposit Rates:                  The weighted average domestic term deposit rate (WADTDR) on outstanding rupee term deposits of SCBs marginally declined to 6.55 per cent in September 2026 from 6.56 per cent in August 2026.                    The WADTDR on fresh rupee term deposits of SCBs declined to 5.61 per cent in September 2026 from 5.67 per cent in August 2026.              Ajit Prasad                Deputy General Manager      (Communications)        Press Release: 2026-2027/1416
topic.title: Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks – October 2026
